How to play Liz:

Store her Green Flame in either Hand or Ultra Space (by Leap effect). For each turn it stays in those zone, it will evolve.
Green Flame -> Mutated Flame -> Deadly Flame
Use mainly Deadly Flame to deal damage
You can used unevolved Green Flame for Leap as needed.

Generate "Green Flame" copy with her 2 cost Shield card, especially when the foe are attempting multiple hits.

For each excess Green Flame or its derivative in Hand, consume them (by playing it with not enough arithmetica) for tiny amount of alienus.

Ideally, you want the ultra space to be filled with her Flame card.

Build her Alienus, and make sure they are ready before entering Ultra turn.
When Ultra turn comes (And your hand are flooded with Deadly Flame), unleash her Exalt.

=========================================
Her Rouse is low Priority, unless you have OverExalt Liz

She does not perform well in Arc2, unless you reach her Overexalt, which makes things much easier and this allow your DPS/Kill moment to be slightly extended outside of UltraTurn.

Even then, she does not perform competitively as DPS in Arc2, but she still somewhat works.
The reason why she does not do well in Arc2, because Arc2 demand speed. 
If arc 2 stages demand you to "You have to kill within X turn", and Liz kit is SLOW and not able to meet this kind of demand.

==================
She will fail against mobs or boss with exaggerated amount of HP (recent D-tide wave 4 and 5)
She just don't have the scaling to tackle insanely large HP foes.

==================
Teammate

Need someone to help survive and delay, and dmg buffer.

content: Hey hey it's hard finding any content of the meta in morimens and I'm quite new to this game; could anyone give me some insight on which teams I could build with my roster, and which of my current characters would be worth investing in?

It is fun because there is lack of guide for meta content.

So my suggestion for having fun is, just go blind. You can only get chance like these on games that many people still don't know of and Morimen combat is fun.

If you still want to, you can seek Flare in YT, but **beware**, he is extremely subjective in his take.
He is... many of the time correct, but on things he don't agree with, he almost don't give it much chance.
Also, his take is if you want to be the top player (like top 1%), casual players can ignore his advice and still have plenty of fun and not much of trouble.

That makes sense, I'll keep it in mind thank you. It does feel a little bit... strange? if I accidentally end up using characters in a team which barely synergize with each other honestly some guidelines to follow do me good

In general, The Arc 2 awakener (new units) are stronger, they are called "ASTRAL REIGN" or "Arc 2 awakeners".
So pulling those, and building your team on those character will make your journey **MUCH** smoother.

And "Faded Legacy" or "Arc 1" awakener are less powerful, so you want to be careful before deciding to pull them.

If you need teammates, you can rely on the standard banner, those characters fulfill their roles decently, and some are used even in endgame, although it's not exactly starightforward to use them in endgame.

When you start the game, in Arc 1 story mode,
You don't have to stress much, and just enjoy learning the teambuilding.
What you learn in Arc 1 (How to teambuild, how to play each realm, how to assign roles) will be valuable until endgame.
